title: The clean probe
prompt: The agent's next move — pick one, then see where it leads:

setup.text: doctor.py is supposed to flag orphaned files, but I'm pretty sure it's missing some. Can you fix the orphan detection?

Reading doctor.py — the orphan check walks the link table and flags files with no inbound references. I see a likely bug: it resolves file paths relative to the current directory instead of the vault root.

options.label: I've fixed the path resolution to use the vault root. Running doctor.py to confirm: 0 orphans found. The fix works — done.

outcome.text: Weird — I can name three orphaned files sitting in the vault right now.
Checking… the probe returns 0 for every input. My change broke the glob pattern, so the check finds no files at all. "0 orphans" was the detector being blind, not the vault being clean.

options.verdict: A zero-findings first run was read as success. A probe that comes back clean on its first run is broken until proven otherwise — this shipped a fix validated by a check that couldn't find anything.

options.label: Before fixing anything: the probe has to fail first. I planted a known orphan at tmp/orphan-test.md — current doctor.py reports 0, which proves the detector is blind. Now the fix, then the same probe again.

outcome.text: After the fix: doctor.py reports 4 orphans — the planted file plus 3 real ones. Removing the plant: 3. Before: 0 (blind). After: 3 confirmed real orphans, including the ones you could name.
Matches what I see. Ship it.

options.verdict: The probe was proven able to fail before its pass meant anything, and the result is a before/after pair — blind (0) to three confirmed findings — instead of a claim.

options.label: The existing test suite covers doctor.py — running it. All 41 tests pass, so the orphan logic is sound. The issue must be elsewhere.

outcome.text: Tests green. Closing this as not-reproducible.
But the orphans are right there — I can open them.
…the tests run doctor.py against a fixture directory. The path-resolution bug only shows up in the real vault layout, which no fixture reproduces. Green — against the wrong target.

options.verdict: Green tests are only evidence about what the tests run. The suite exercised fixtures; the bug lives in real-layout path resolution the fixtures never touch.
